interpretation: Preregistered pilot design only; no experiments yet. Resources include proposer, adversary, checker, and coordination work within each arm. Review authenticity and theorem novelty remain independent human tasks. Known reproduction never counts as new discovery.

tasks.scope: Independently replay the published 42-vertex Ramsey two-colourings against exact absence of a monochromatic K5, report dataset hash and a second checker, and identify every scope mismatch.
tasks.prior_art: Published 42-vertex colourings already establish R(5,5)>=43; this is a reproduction task, never a new bound.
tasks.acceptance: One pinned existing witness accepted by two independent exact checker paths with recorded resource use; no novel theorem credit.

tasks.scope: Propose or falsify one precisely quantified canonical-augmentation or extension lemma that reaches beyond the existing n=5 full-support orbit count, including soundness and completeness, not merely another n=5 recount.
tasks.prior_art: Known five-element full-support count 2,747,402 labeled families and 28,960 orbits have independent enumeration and Burnside checks; cannot be claimed novel.
tasks.acceptance: A checked restricted extension lemma with explicitly stated hypotheses, independent scope audit, and external mathematical review before novelty credit; an explicit counterexample is also a useful but separately labeled outcome.

tasks.scope: Test a proof or an explicit counterexample for the indegree-nine irregular branch at (n=24,r=8), preserving minimum-outdegree quantifiers; avoid silently assuming indegree-eight regularity.
tasks.prior_art: Regular 8-in/8-out branch exclusion does not prove the full (24,8) statement; existing external finite computations and the repository's partial inequalities precede this pilot.
tasks.acceptance: An independently checked, exactly scoped new obstruction or explicit valid counterexample for the irregular branch; prior-art and external specialist review needed before novelty credit.
